items.title: 初次见面
items.text: ﻿你好，我叫菲米尼，是一名潜水员…啊，握手的话就不必了…我是说，不用那么客气。咳、如果你需要勘测水下遗迹或者打捞素材的话，我能为你所用…但其他方面的指派，我可能会让你失望…
items.text_en: Hello, my name's Freminet, I'm a diver... Oh, no need to shake hands. I mean, no need to be so formal. Ahem, if you need help surveying underwater ruins or salvaging materials, I can be of some use to you. But for anything else... You might find me a disappointment.

items.title: 闲聊·海底
items.text: ﻿想去无人的海底，一个人安静地待着…
items.text_en: I want to spend some time at the bottom of the sea... In peace and total silence.

items.title: 闲聊·原理
items.text: ﻿熟悉机械装置的构造与原理，就能够排查故障…但要熟悉一个人却难得多。
items.text_en: It's easy to fix a machine when you know how it's built and how it works. But people... they're much more difficult.

items.title: 闲聊·家
items.text: ﻿无论我在何处漂流，只要那盏炉火亮着，我就有家可归…
items.text_en: Wherever the tide takes me, so long as the light of the hearth still shines, I'll always have a home to return to...

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: ﻿每到雨天，心情都会沉重不少…
items.text_en: I always get so gloomy when it rains...

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: ﻿雨停了吗？那就好。
items.text_en: The rain's stopped? Okay, that's good.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: ﻿佩伊，我会保护你的。不要怕。
items.text_en: Don't be scared, Pers. I'll keep you safe.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: ﻿我是不是应该把潜水头盔戴上…保暖…
items.text_en: Maybe I should put on my diving helmet to... keep me warm...

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 想钻进海里。
items.text_en: I'd rather be diving in the sea.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早。请问，有需要我执行的任务吗？没有的话，我准备出门了。
items.text_en: Morning. Do you have an assignment for me today? If not, I'll head out.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 机械内部没有故障，是发条老化了吗？那修起来简单…抱歉，我…呃…你刚才和我说了什么吗？
items.text_en: All the components look intact. Maybe it's just a worn-out spring? If so, that's an easy fix... Oh, sorry, I was... Did you say something?

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 要来一碗海鲜汤吗？是用今天现捕的虾和贝类做的。我不怎么会做饭，但食材新鲜，味道…应该不会太差。
items.text_en: Want a bowl of seafood soup? It's made with shrimp and shellfish caught earlier today. I'm no cook, but the ingredients are fresh, so... it shouldn't taste too bad.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 你休息吧。我还想看一会儿书再睡。欸？什么书？这个…唔，是有关潜、潜水的书，有很多技术要点要学…总之，先道晚安了！
items.text_en: You go ahead, I'm gonna stay up and read for a while. Hmm? What am I reading? It's, um... it's about diving. There's a bunch of skills that I still need to... Anyway, night!

items.title: 关于菲米尼自己·潜水
items.text: 如你所知，我为数不多的强项是潜水，我和汐藻打交道的时间比和人说话的时间还多。它们不会责问，不会流露失望，只安静地陪你一同漂流…水下的世界要比陆上简单许多。
items.text_en: As you know, diving is one of the few things I'm any good at. I spend more time among the Tidalga than I do talking to people. They don't ask you questions or act disappointed, they just float there quietly with you... The underwater world is much simpler than the world of dry land.

items.title: 关于菲米尼自己·发条企鹅
items.text: 在我感到孤独的夜晚，是佩伊给了我最珍贵的陪伴。我想，或许有其他孩子像我一样，需要一位陪在身边的玩具伙伴。于是，我做了一批发条企鹅，拿去莱舒的发条工坊寄售…听说口碑不错，但销量一般，来购买的反倒是成年人居多…唉。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Whenever I feel lonely at night, Pers is the one who's always there for me. I thought that maybe some other kids might want a toy for company too, so I made a bunch of clockwork penguins and took them to Leschots's workshop to put on sale... Apparently, the customer feedback was good, but they didn't sell too many of them. And most of the buyers were adults...

items.title: 关于我们·命令
items.text: 「命令」就像是背在我身后的发条，离开它反而令我不习惯。如果有任何对我的安排，请你一定不要顾虑。
items.text_en: Orders to me are like a clockwork spring driving me forward, and I don't know what to do with myself without them. So if there's anything you need me for, please don't hesitate to ask.

items.title: 关于我们·同伴
items.text: 让我多了解一点你的事吧。你的爱好、口味，喜欢的颜色，想养的动物…既然你是我的「同伴」，那我们之间的联结，就比齿轮与机关更紧密了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Tell me a bit more about yourself. Your hobbies, favorite food, favorite color, what animal you'd like to have as a pet... If you and I are companions, it means we're connected, more closely than gears in a machine.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 自从有了「神之眼」，我潜水已经不再需要使用头盔。但我却离不开它。它将我与外界的嘈杂隔绝，让我感到安全。「神之眼」、头盔…还有佩伊，我的呼吸，一直在借助它们的力量。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4After I got my Vision, I didn't need my helmet to go diving anymore. But... I can't bear to be without it. It cuts me off from the noise of the outside world, and makes me feel safe. My Vision, Pers, and my helmet... I draw my strength from them every time I take a breath.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 透过海水望天，阳光也不会那么刺眼。所以，我才总是愿意待在水里。
items.text_en: If you look up at the sky from far enough underwater, even the sun is soft on the eyes. That's why I like it down there.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻·苍晶螺
items.text: 我曾在水下见到过许多苍晶螺，盯着那些精致细巧的纹路，不知不觉就忘记了时间。这么美丽的生物已经变成了化石，那我们周围的景色，是不是早晚也会沉入深海之下呢？
items.text_en: I've seen lots of Beryl Conches down in the depths. The patterns are so intricate, I often lose track of the time just staring at them. These fossils are all that's left of these beautiful creatures... I wonder how long before the rest of the world becomes part of this underwater museum, too?

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻·幽光星星
items.text: 幽光星星总是会依附在其他东西之上，有时是礁石，有时是码头，更多时候则是庞大的水下建筑群。你说，它们是不是就像飞萤靠近光源那样，对人类心存向往呢？
items.text_en: Lumitoile attach themselves to many things. Sometimes on the reefs or docks, but most commonly on large underwater buildings. Do you think they're drawn to humans like Cicins are drawn to the light?

items.title: 关于「父亲」·眼泪
items.text: 「父亲」不喜欢孩子们哭，说眼泪是感性和软弱的混合物。被「父亲」训斥过后，我总要忍到水下才敢哭出来。还好海露花会陪着我。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4"Father" doesn't like it when children cry. "Father" says tears are the product of emotion and weakness. So when "Father" scolds me, I hold it in until I'm underwater, where no one can hear me cry. At least I have the Romaritime Flowers to keep me company.

items.title: 关于「父亲」·教导
items.text: 小时候，我受到的教育是：为了家，我们应该献出自己的生命。自从「父亲」掌权后，这一理念产生了变化。「父亲」说我们每一个人都很重要，必须得重视自己的生命，发挥所有力量，在这个世界上站稳脚跟…说实话，这比单纯服从命令难多了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"When I was little, I was taught that we should be ready to give our lives for our family. But when "Father" took control, this philosophy changed. "Father" said that every one of us is important, and we have to value our own lives, be our strongest selves, and stand on our own two feet in this world... But actually, all of that's much harder than just following orders.

items.title: 关于林尼·表演
items.text: 在家里，林尼时常会向我表演一些小魔术。一旦我笑了的话，他就会特别开心，说那个魔术肯定会让观众都满意…我平时真的笑那么少吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4At home, Lyney's always showing me his magic tricks. Whenever I smile, he grins excitedly and says the audience is definitely going to love this one... Do I really smile so rarely?

items.title: 关于林尼·面具
items.text: 林尼是我们小队中的领袖，总是以哥哥的身份自居…我能看出他硬撑的时候，也尝试过劝他不要一直戴着面具…但他不肯承认，我们还起过争执…从那之后，我就不再触碰这个话题了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Lyney is our team leader, and acts like everyone's older brother... But I can tell that he puts on a brave face sometimes. I tried to talk to him about it once — told him that he doesn't need to wear a mask all the time. But he denied it, and we ended up having an argument... Since then, I've never brought it up with him again.

items.title: 关于琳妮特
items.text: 同样的任务，如果交给林尼或者琳妮特，他们就能完成得很出色，而我却办不好。琳妮特总宽慰我说大家各有所长，家里那些突然出故障的器械都在靠我维修…哈，我在其他方面也能这么得心应手就好了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4If you assigned Lyney and Lynette with the same mission, they'd both do an outstanding job. But not me. Lynette is always comforting me, saying that everyone has their strengths, and how everyone relies on me to fix things around the house when they break down... If only I was half as good at anything else.

items.title: 关于那维莱特
items.text: 有次我浮出海面时，正巧见到最高审判官大人独自站在海边。他或许在想心事，或许在看风景…我当然没问。我只和他匆匆对了一眼就潜回海里了。事后想想像是做了亏心事一样…唉。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4One day when I surfaced after a dive, the Chief Justice was just standing there alone on the beach. I don't know whether he had something on his mind, or was just enjoying the view... Obviously, I didn't ask. I only locked eyes with him for a split-second before disappearing back underwater. Thinking back, I must have looked so guilty... *sigh*

items.title: 关于芙宁娜·回避
items.text: 我…我没法客观地评价水神大人，还是…不说了吧。况且我和她接触得也不多…看法肯定会有偏颇。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Uh... I'm in no position to give a well-rounded opinion on the Hydro Archon, so... I'll pass. I mean, I've only seen her a few times... so I'm sure I have a somewhat skewed view of her.

items.title: 关于芙宁娜·判断
items.text: 好吧，我见过水神大人坐在观众席上的样子。在我看来，她说话的时候非常引人瞩目，沉默的时候反倒更耐人寻味…她的眼睛，就像不透光的海底那样，藏着深深的秘密，害怕他人的碰触…我、我乱说的…对不起。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6...Okay fine. I've seen what the Hydro Archon's like when she's sitting in the audience. In my view, she's a very charismatic speaker, but it's her silences that intrigue me more. Her eyes... they're like the darkness at the bottom of the ocean. Hiding a deep secret, afraid of anyone ever getting close to her... Ah! Sorry, I... I let my imagination get the better of me.

items.title: 关于娜维娅
items.text: 我听林尼聊了事情经过，很感谢你和娜维娅小姐的慷慨与热心，也请代我向她转达…欸？当面道谢？我、我有点…唔，肚子突然疼起来了，抱歉先走一步。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"Lyney told me everything. I'm so grateful to you and Navia for your warmth and generosity. Please pass on my thanks when you see her... Huh? Tell her myself? ...Uh, I, uh... Ooh, I've suddenly got stomach cramps — sorry, gotta dash.

items.title: 关于夏洛蒂
items.text: 不知道为什么，夏洛蒂小姐始终不愿相信我是一名普通的潜水员，反倒觉得我的身世藏有值得报道的「新闻」…是我说谎的时候不够自然吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4For some reason, Charlotte never believes me when I say I'm just an ordinary diver. She's convinced that my past is full of news stories waiting for her to dig up... Am I really that bad of a liar?

items.title: 关于夏沃蕾
items.text: 听说夏沃蕾小姐常去博蒙特工坊，为火枪购置最昂贵精细的零件。我要是能挣到很多钱的话，说不定也能给佩伊换上性能更好的零件了吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I hear that Chevreuse is a regular customer of Beaumont Workshop. She always purchases the most expensive and advanced components for her musket. If I make enough Mora, maybe one day I can afford to upgrade Pers's components.

items.title: 想要了解菲米尼·其一
items.text: 请原谅。我讲不出什么有趣的故事…说了也会扫你兴致…
items.text_en: I'm sorry, I can't really think of any good stories to share... the ones I do know will just bring down your mood.

items.title: 想要了解菲米尼·其二
items.text: 要是你答应不看着我，或者允许我戴上头盔的话…我可以试着说下去。心理素质是一方面…但更主要的原因，恐怕是我习惯了逃避自己的过去…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3My past... If you promise not to look at me, or you'll let me wear my diving helmet... Maybe then I could try to tell you a little more. Personality's one part of it, but... the bigger reason is that I've been avoiding my past for so long now, it might be hard to talk about...

items.title: 想要了解菲米尼·其三
items.text: 书上说，人死后会化作天上的星辰，遥望人世…我讨厌自己的亲生父亲，他抛下了我和母亲，我不在乎他…但如果母亲在天上看见她用生命保护下来的孩子如此怯弱，躲在另一个屋檐下那么久，也没有成长为独当一面的样子，她会不会…对我感到失望呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"I read in a book that when people die, they turn into stars and watch over us from the sky... I hate my real father. He abandoned my mother and me, so I don't care about him. But... if my mother looks down from the sky and sees that, after all this time in his new home, the child she protected with her life is still so timid that he can't fend for himself... Will she be... disappointed in me?

items.title: 想要了解菲米尼·其四
items.text: 我不太想回忆前任院长管理时期的「家」。只能说…躲进海里的习惯，就是那时候养成的…但「父亲」不仅改变了我，也改变了我对「家」的看法…后来林尼和琳妮特也成为了我们的「家人」…那是我第一次遇到能交心的伙伴。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"I don't like thinking about my time in the House of the Hearth under the previous director. All I'll say is... My habit of retreating into the sea started back then. "Father" changed not only me, but my view of our family, too. Then Lyney and Lynette joined the family... and for the first time ever, I gained some genuine companions.

items.title: 想要了解菲米尼·其五
items.text: 我曾发誓，我会不惜一切地守护现在这个家，一丝一毫都不退让。它不再是前任院长的命令，或者「父亲」的期待…而是我自己的愿望。请你保守「家」的秘密…还有我的愿望。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"I once swore an oath that I would do whatever it takes to protect this family, and never look back. Now, I stay true to this oath not because it's the previous director's orders, or because it's what "Father" expects of me, but because it's my own desire. Please keep our family's secret safe... so that I can keep my promise.

items.title: 菲米尼的爱好
items.text: 除了潜水之外，我还喜欢拆解和改造机械，有时也会把收集来的材料制作成新的发条玩具。佩伊？它更像是我的家人，和我一起长大…是真的。我一直在为它增添更多功能…真希望未来有一天，它能够自由地飞上高空。
items.text_en: Apart from diving, my main hobby is dismantling mechanical things and modifying them. I also collect spare parts, and sometimes I build new clockwork toys out of them. ...Pers? No, Pers is more like family to me. We grew up together... No, I'm serious. I'm always tinkering with it to add more functionality... I truly hope that a day will come when Pers can fly free into the sky.

items.title: 菲米尼的烦恼
items.text: …真难回答啊。既可以说我没有亟待解决的问题，又可以说我身上麻烦重重。即使将我自己看作一台橱窗里的发条玩偶，我也想不出要从哪里开始维修…症结可能还是会落回…我太弱小了吧。
items.text_en: ...That's a tough question. I don't have any critical issues that need addressing, but at the same time, there's a long laundry list of minor things which all take their toll. If I was a clockwork toy on the shelf, I wouldn't even know where to start trying to fix me up... But at the end of the day, I guess it all comes down to one thing... I'm just too weak.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 鱼、虾之类的海鲜…螃蟹也可以。我很高兴自己和林尼、琳妮特他们口味相近，大家能吃到一起去…在烹饪形式的选择上，我会尊重他们的意见。
items.text_en: Seafood. Mainly fish and shrimp, crab's okay too. I'm really glad that Lyney and Lynette share my tastes, because it means we can eat meals together... I don't mind how the ingredients are cooked, though. I leave that decision up to them.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 我不太能喝咖啡。一旦超过半杯，没过多久，心脏就会跳得很快，呼吸也没法恢复平稳。人们常说咖啡有提神的效用，但对我来说，它更像是一种折磨…
items.text_en: I can't handle coffee. More than half a cup and before long, my heart starts racing and I can't calm my breathing down. Everyone says that coffee can boost your energy levels, but to me, it's torture...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 好吃。好吃到让人舍不得吃完。
items.text_en: It's good. So good, I don't want to eat all of it in one go.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 烹饪是你的爱好吗？所以你才会不断投入心血，做出这些美味的菜肴。
items.text_en: Is cooking one of your hobbies? It shows. I can taste how much care you put into these delicious meals.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 对不起，刚才我有一瞬间想要逃走。明明是你辛苦做出来的东西…
items.text_en: Sorry... For a moment there I had the urge to run for my life. But that wouldn't be fair to you.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 你愿意跟我去个地方吗？我知道一片水域，景色特别漂亮，甚至比书里描绘的世界更加梦幻。我在那里有个秘密基地，还养了一些会发光的海洋生物…我想陪你度过一个不一样的生日，最后再说出那句祝福…能给我这个机会吗？
items.text_en: Would you be willing to come with me somewhere? There's this place I know where the scenery is spectacular. I think it's even more magical than a fantasy novel. I have a secret hideout there, and I keep some glowing sea creatures as pets... I just want to give you a birthday experience like you've never had before, and then give you my birthday wishes... Will you give me the chance to do that?

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 真的…可以吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Are... Are you sure?

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 即使不为我做这些，我也会服从你的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2You didn't have to do this for me, you know. I'd obey you regardless.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 你的时间和精力非常宝贵，拿去陪别人会更好…吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4Your time and energy is a precious resource. Shouldn't you... spend it on someone else?

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 我不知道如何才能报答你，要怎样表达才足够传递自己的想法…我…我平时练习太少，现在非常害怕会说错话…让你不开心，让你觉得后悔…对不起，我可以什么都不说，就在你身边待一会儿吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6How can I ever repay you for this? I don't know what to say, I... I don't have much practice at this, and right now I'm terrified of saying something stupid and upsetting you... and making you regret this whole thing... I'm sorry, is it okay if I just... say nothing, and just stay here with you for a while?

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 佩伊！
items.text_en: Pers!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 运转吧。
items.text_en: Get in gear.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 寒潮将至。
items.text_en: Frost is coming.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 下潜…就绪。
items.text_en: Going under.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 清剿…开始。
items.text_en: Commencing cleanup.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 该道别了。
items.text_en: Dead reckoning.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 如果有你不需要的金属碎片或者零件，可以丢给我。
items.text_en: If there's any scrap metal or parts you don't want, I'll take them.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 好多宝藏。
items.text_en: There's a lot of treasure here.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 分类存放吧。
items.text_en: Sort the items by type and store them for future use.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 区区疼痛而已。
items.text_en: I've had worse.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 我还能承受…
items.text_en: I can take it...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 要恢复…呼吸节奏。
items.text_en: Just keep breathing...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 你的伤口…
items.text_en: You're wounded...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 你…要不要…
items.text_en: Um, maybe... You should...

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 我还是…无处可归…
items.text_en: No home... to return to...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 要沉入海底了吗？…
items.text_en: Sinking... feeling...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 「父亲」…
items.text_en: "Father"...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 不好…
items.text_en: Oh no...

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 不要…
items.text_en: Please, no...

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 带我走吧。
items.text_en: Yes, take me with you.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 命令我吧。
items.text_en: At your command.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 我还能去哪里呢…
items.text_en: Well, I've got nowhere to go...
